title: Chieng no Odwaro Yawore
stanzas: Chieng`no maduong` to nobinwa piyo, mar biro Yesu;Nobi ni mondo oter nyithinde e utgi malo.
Wach mar injili nolandre piyo ni dhoudi te;Eka Ruoth Yesu Kristo noduogi, mi bu noyuagi .
Jopolo duto nokowe bende e boche polo;Ruodhwa nobi tero jo makare kama tho onge.
Jo ma wahero to koro nindo; to wananere;Ok wanayuagi e pinyruodh polo, wanamor kende.
chorus: Ti waneno chieng`no odwaro yawore,Koriembo mudho me piny;Ti waneno chieng`no odwaro yawore,Konyruok chiegni.
